BXAGI Workflow SC Subset

This is a modified static-weight subset of Noto Sans SC obtained from the official Google Fonts repository.
Original source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
Original font download: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf

The modified font family is BXAGI Workflow SC Subset; it does not use the Reserved Font Name.
Modification: retained only these characters: BXAGI 智能调度实测 流程测试素材 这是用于验证流程的测试素材 不包含商品价格、优惠或效果承诺 仅用于流程验证，不进行广告投放, instantiated weight 400, and renamed the family and PostScript names.
